Name: Self-Sufficient Seed Makers
Author: AmishIT
Description:
[i]Self-Sufficient Seed Makers[/i] changes seed makers to make them usable throughout a playthrough.

With this mod, seed makers produce more seeds (no longer will you get a [i]single[/i] seed from a crop), they are unlocked at Farming level 1 instead of 9, and they cost an Earth Crystal instead of a gold bar.

Several config options are available (plus support for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] by spacechase0):
[list]
[*]Set the min/max number of seeds that are produced[/*]
[*]Set the Farming level the seed maker unlocks at[/*]
[*]Remove the chance to produce mixed seeds[/*]
[*]Remove the chance to produce one ancient seed[/*]
[*]Change the replacement for the gold bar in the recipe[/*]
[/list]
Requires [i]SMAPI[/i].

To manually install, unzip into a folder in your "Stardew Valley/Mods/" folder.

[line]

I made this mod to work in conjunction with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26086]Realistic Seasonal Shop Inventory[/url] by boringvlln, making for a harder and more-varied early game that relies heavily on seed makers.

I made this mod for myself a while back, but I figured someone else might like it, so here we are.  Buyer beware: Don't expect timely support or updates.

[url=https://github.com/Amish-IT/self-sufficient-seed-makers]Github[/url]
